correctness.rationale: A direct evaluation of source equations (6)-(7) yields the exact full-occupancy inward derivative; species coordinate planes are invariant. With 0<epsilon<=1, concavity in the prey/predator split proves both-edge extremality and the edge quadratic is nonnegative iff the square-root threshold holds. The tangent-cone criterion establishes all-initial-state global forward invariance, and violating any test yields an immediate outward state. The alpha=1, zero-coefficient and equality cases are included. An exact-rational verifier independently checked 5000 test tuples, 330000 boundary grid points, source outward-witness fluxes and the xi=9/10 cutoff. The symbolic proof, not finite testing, covers the quantified theorem.

originality.rationale: The complete primary 2023 model article and its arXiv preprint supply equations and selected-trajectory ecology, not a global invariant-region parameter classification. A later closely related 2024 full paper treats an antisymmetric win/loss payoff matrix; the pairwise terms then cancel in total population at full occupancy, unlike the 2023 asymmetric conversion coefficients. A published carrying-simplex analysis addresses a different invariant object. Exact same-object and reduction comparisons, research-record searches and own earlier-claim deduplication found no coverage. Unindexed equivalent specialized work remains possible; this is a best-knowledge, not exclusivity, judgment.
residual_risks: Earlier specialized literature or supplemental derivations may contain a mathematically equivalent viability classification under another model name.
Only the main relevant sections of the later 2024 primary paper were materially read; no claim is made that all appendices of every comparator have been exhausted.
Results from abstract-only carrying-simplex references cannot justify exhaustive no-coverage declarations.
The verdict distinguishes universal simplex feasibility from selected simulated trajectories; conflating these would invalidate originality and significance.

value.rationale: The source model defines species fractions of a finite habitat; their total must not exceed one. The complete sharp parameter feasibility domain for every physical initial composition is a meaningful natural invariant-region classification, distinct from positivity or selected-solution boundedness. A strict edge-reduction lemma, independence from free-space benefit parameters, and explicit sharp failure/cutoff at the published reference values give interpretability and parameter-design consequences beyond an isolated negative check. The result makes no general persistence or trajectory claim.
